proofs. Pillow is required, as for the existing workbench visual checker.

negative_checks.reason: The synthetic focus-loss event lacked the existing fixture marker and was filtered.
Instrumentation confirmed the event was filtered; this is not a passed focus-loss check.
Actual font advance exceeded the fixed tab width.
The test incorrectly required physical mouse capture although posted SDL events do not move the physical pointer.
Shared separator press rounded a half-pixel origin to an extra pixel; the hidden launcher also lacked ProgramFiles system variables.
The width drag was corrected, but global Defaults still retained the regular layout. Compiler setup did not restore missing ProgramFiles variables.
All other 14 Windows workflow groups passed; the expanded workbench helper missed its jump back to stage 32 and timed out.

limitations: Windows scripted pointer events do not move the physical pointer; SDL capture flags are checked against actual mouse focus. No full physical Windows pointer proof is claimed.
No new macOS, manual screenreader or physical mixed-monitor DPI proof.
Builds include the separately hashed unchanged foreign accessibility files. No clean-checkout build is claimed.
